description: Every local file the server keeps, in one look, with no Suunto call and no credentials: journal, plan, catch-up marker, prediction ledger, experiments, approval queue (path, status, version, size, mode, counts) and the cache, archive and reports folders. status: ok, missing, unreadable, damaged, foreign (not a suunto-mcp file of that kind), newer-version (refused, left untouched) or in-memory (demo). `modeWarning` flags a file not 0600 (or a folder not 0700). Nothing is modified, created or repaired.
name: get_data_overview
title: Get an overview of the local files the server keeps (read-only)
